import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianCoherence
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FiniteSupportVanishing
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.ModuleGlobalGeneration
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundleRegularSection
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianCandidateSupport
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LocallyFreeRank

/-!
# Sections killed by the Grassmannian candidate

A nonzero kernel of the Grassmannian quotient over an affine test produces
a nonzero section of the pulled-back line bundle killed by the reconstructed
quotient. The canonical section base-change map is required to be invertible.
This is the section input to finite support in the divisor construction.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- An affine Grassmannian test with nonzero kernel supplies a nonzero section
killed by the actual candidate quotient. -/
theorem exists_nonzero_section_candidateQuotient
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {T : Over S} [IsAffine T.left]
    (L : X.Modules) [((Modules.pushforward π).obj L).IsQuasicoherent] {d : ℕ}
    (q : LocallyFreeQuotient ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d T)
    [IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L)]
    (hK : ¬ IsZero (kernel q.q)) :
    ∃ s : (SheafOfModules.unit (pullback π T.hom).ringCatSheaf :
        (pullback π T.hom).Modules) ⟶
        (Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)).obj L,
      s ≠ 0 ∧ s ≫ candidateQuotient L q = 0 := by
  haveI : q.F.IsQuasicoherent := q.locFree.isQuasicoherent
  haveI : ((Modules.pullback T.hom).obj
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L)).IsQuasicoherent :=
    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom T.hom _ inferInstance
  haveI : (kernel q.q).IsQuasicoherent :=
    Modules.kernel_isQuasicoherent q.q inferInstance inferInstance
  have hΓ : ¬ Subsingleton Γ(kernel q.q, (⊤ : T.left.Opens)) :=
    fun h => hK (Modules.isZero_of_subsingleton_sections_of_isAffine _ h)
  letI : Nontrivial Γ(kernel q.q, (⊤ : T.left.Opens)) :=
    not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.mp hΓ
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_ne (0 : Γ(kernel q.q, (⊤ : T.left.Opens)))
  let v : (SheafOfModules.unit T.left.ringCatSheaf : T.left.Modules) ⟶ kernel q.q :=
    Modules.homOfGlobalSection (kernel q.q) a
  have hv : v ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply ha
    have htop := congrArg (fun f : (SheafOfModules.unit T.left.ringCatSheaf :
        T.left.Modules) ⟶ kernel q.q => Modules.Hom.app f ⊤ (1 : Γ(T.left, ⊤))) h
    simpa [v] using htop
  let p := pullback.snd π T.hom
  let b := (canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L
  let adj := Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p
  let eO := Modules.pullbackUnitIso p
  let s := eO.inv ≫ (Modules.pullback p).map v ≫ kernelEvaluation L q
  refine ⟨s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hs
    have htrans : v ≫ kernel.ι q.q ≫ b = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (adj.homEquiv _ _) (show
          (Modules.pullback p).map v ≫ kernelEvaluation L q = 0 by
        apply (cancel_epi eO.inv).mp
        simpa [s] using hs)
      simpa only [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left, kernelEvaluation, adj, p, b,
        Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Adjunction.homAddEquiv_zero] using h
    haveI : IsIso b := inferInstance
    apply hv
    apply (cancel_mono (kernel.ι q.q ≫ b)).mp
    simpa using htrans
  · simp [s, candidateQuotient, Category.assoc, cokernel.condition]

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Over an integral affine test family, the candidate avoids the generic
point as soon as the Grassmannian kernel is nonzero. -/
theorem genericPoint_not_mem_candidateSupport
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {T : Over S} [IsAffine T.left]
    [IsIntegral (pullback π T.hom)]
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
    [((Modules.pushforward π).obj L).IsQuasicoherent] {d : ℕ}
    (q : LocallyFreeQuotient ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d T)
    [IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback π T.hom)).app L)]
    [(cokernel (kernelEvaluation L q)).IsFinitePresentation]
    (hK : ¬ IsZero (kernel q.q)) :
    genericPoint (pullback π T.hom : Scheme.{u}) ∉
      (Modules.annihilator (cokernel (kernelEvaluation L q))).support := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsq⟩ := exists_nonzero_section_candidateQuotient L q hK
  have hLt := hL.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)
  haveI : Mono s := LineBundle.mono_unit_hom_of_ne_zero _ hLt s hs
  haveI : Epi (candidateQuotient L q) := candidateQuotient_epi L q
  exact Modules.genericPoint_not_mem_annihilator_support_of_mono_section
    s (candidateQuotient L q) hsq hLt

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- A field-valued Grassmannian quotient with nonzero kernel reconstructs a
quotient whose schematic support is finite on the proper smooth curve. -/
theorem isFinite_candidateSupport_of_field
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (τ : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (L : C.left.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) {d : ℕ}
    (q : LocallyFreeQuotient ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L) d (Over.mk τ))
    (hK : ¬ IsZero (kernel q.q)) :
    IsFinite (Modules.schematicSupportι (cokernel (kernelEvaluation L q)) ≫
      pullback.snd C.hom τ) := by
  haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation := hL.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L).IsQuasicoherent :=
    Modules.pushforward_isQuasicoherent C.hom L
  haveI : IsProper (pullback.snd C.hom τ) := inferInstance
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback C.hom τ) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (pullback.snd C.hom τ)
  haveI : IsAffine (Over.mk τ).left :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsAffine (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback C.hom (Over.mk τ).hom) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback C.hom τ))
  haveI : (cokernel (kernelEvaluation L q)).IsFinitePresentation :=
    candidateQuotient_isFinitePresentation L q
  haveI : IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback C.hom τ)).app L) :=
    canonicalBaseChangeMap_isIso (IsPullback.of_hasPullback C.hom τ) L
  haveI : IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback C.hom (Over.mk τ).hom)).app L) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsIso
      ((canonicalBaseChangeMap (IsPullback.of_hasPullback C.hom τ)).app L))
  letI : MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange (@SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1) :=
    smoothOfRelativeDimension_isStableUnderBaseChange 1
  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (pullback.snd C.hom τ) :=
    MorphismProperty.pullback_snd _ _ (inferInstance : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Over.mk (pullback.snd C.hom τ)).hom :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (pullback.snd C.hom τ))
  haveI : IsIntegral (Over.mk (pullback.snd C.hom τ)).left :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsIntegral (pullback C.hom τ))
  haveI : IsProper (Over.mk (pullback.snd C.hom τ)).hom :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsProper (pullback.snd C.hom τ))
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsq⟩ := exists_nonzero_section_candidateQuotient L q hK
  have hLt := hL.pullback (pullback.fst C.hom τ)
  haveI : Mono s := LineBundle.mono_unit_hom_of_ne_zero _ hLt s hs
  haveI : Epi (candidateQuotient L q) := candidateQuotient_epi L q
  exact Modules.isFinite_schematicSupport_of_mono_section
    (Over.mk (pullback.snd C.hom τ)) s (candidateQuotient L q) hsq hLt

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- A strict rank gap supplies finite support for every field-valued
Grassmannian candidate; no nonzero-section hypothesis remains. -/
theorem isFinite_candidateSupport_of_field_of_rank_lt
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (τ : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (L : C.left.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) {r d : ℕ}
    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L) r)
    (hdr : d < r)
    (q : LocallyFreeQuotient ((Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj L) d (Over.mk τ)) :
    IsFinite (Modules.schematicSupportι (cokernel (kernelEvaluation L q)) ≫
      pullback.snd C.hom τ) := by
  haveI : Epi q.q := q.epi
  exact isFinite_candidateSupport_of_field C τ L hL q
    (Modules.not_isZero_kernel_of_locallyFree_rank_ne
      (Modules.pullback_isLocallyFreeOfRank (Over.mk τ).hom hV) q.locFree
      (Nat.ne_of_gt hdr) (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) q.q)

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient
